max_line_width.description: int, optional Inserts newlines if text is longer than `max_line_width`. Defaults to ``numpy.get_printoptions()['linewidth']``.

precision.description: int, optional Floating point precision. Defaults to ``numpy.get_printoptions()['precision']``.

suppress_small.description: bool, optional Represent numbers "very close" to zero as zero; default is False. Very close is defined by precision: if the precision is 8, e.g., numbers smaller (in absolute value) than 5e-9 are represented as zero. Defaults to ``numpy.get_printoptions()['suppress']``.
constraints: suppress_small must be one of suppress

output.description: ------- str The string representation of an array.
